_doc: LLM Router admin config. Edit + upload to S3; the router hot-reloads within ~60s (no redeploy). Validated on load; invalid config -> router falls back to last-known-good, then baked-in defaults.

tiers._doc: target-qualified model per tier, per caller API family. Add/rename tiers freely; every task_base value and escalation value must exist here.

task_base._doc: task -> base tier. To add a task type: add it here AND in questions.task.criteria below.

escalation._doc: where a tier escalates to when a prompt's complexity exceeds the threshold

task.instructions: What kind of task is this request?

criteria.simple_qa: Simple factual question or short chat
criteria.classification: Categorize, tag, label or detect sentiment/intent of given text
criteria.extraction: Extract structured fields or data points from provided text
criteria.summarization: Summarize, condense or produce key points of provided content
criteria.rewriting: Edit, proofread, rephrase or change tone of provided text
criteria.customer_support: Draft a helpful response to a customer inquiry or complaint
criteria.rag_qa: Answer a question using provided documents/context/knowledge base
criteria.content_generation: Create marketing copy, emails, posts, docs or other business content
criteria.creative_writing: Fiction, stories, poetry or other creative prose
criteria.coding: Write or modify functions and features, unit tests, standard debugging, moderate SQL, infrastructure-as-code, or code review
criteria.reasoning_planning: Deep multi-step reasoning, strategy or complex planning
criteria.agentic: Orchestrating multi-step workflows, tools or autonomous task execution
criteria.code_simple: Explain or comment code, small snippets or one-liners, regex, code formatting, simple SQL queries, or mechanical code transforms (rename, add types/docstrings)
criteria.code_architecture: System or schema design, technology tradeoff decisions, novel algorithm design, performance or concurrency engineering, or migration strategy
criteria.sysadmin_scripting: Write automation scripts for system administration: shell/bash/PowerShell, cron jobs, log parsing, backup/deploy scripts, server or cloud-resource automation
criteria.product_requirements: Product management work: gather or refine requirements, write user stories with acceptance criteria, PRDs, epics, feature specs for development handoff

complexity.instructions: How complex is this request for an AI assistant?

param_normalization._doc: models whose OpenAI dialect needs max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens (substring match)

decision_engines._doc: jev.endpoint options: https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions (model typesafe/jev-1.13) or TypeSafe native https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone (model jev-1.13.0). secret_name holds {"apiKey":"..."} in Secrets Manager.
